title: AI Capability Selector
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners match four sales-storytelling use cases to the AI capability that serves each: NLP, speech recognition, sentiment AI, or emotion AI.

learningObjectives: Select appropriate AI capabilities (NLP, Speech Recognition, Sentiment AI, Emotion AI) for different storytelling use cases.
prerequisites: Story Artificial Intelligence, Story Natural Language Processing, and Story Sentiment AI sections of Chapter 16

keyQuestions: Select appropriate AI capabilities (NLP, Speech Recognition, Sentiment AI, Emotion AI) for different storytelling use cases.
commonMisconceptions: Any AI works for any task.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct capability for all four use cases.
Learner can explain the difference between sentiment AI and emotion AI.
